title: 第17章 温柔的陷阱
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周二中午，食堂。

    苏念念和安槐刚坐下，周小鱼从后面挤过来，脸上的笑比平时亮了好几度。

    “念念！你猜谁给我送了笔记？”

    苏念念嚼着红烧肉，含糊地问。“谁？”

    “林落雪！她把灵气感知课的笔记整理了一份给我，还画了图解，超清楚的！”

    周小鱼把几页纸递过来，安槐的目光扫了一眼，字迹清秀工整，重点用彩色笔标注，图解画得一丝不苟。

    确实用心。

    太用心了。

    “她怎么知道你需要笔记？”安槐随口问。

    “我上次在班群里发了条消息，说灵气感知课的内容有点难消化，她就私信我了，说可以把自己的笔记分享给我。”周小鱼感动得眼睛发亮，“人也太好了吧。”

    苏念念看了看那份笔记，嗯了一声，没发表意见，继续吃饭。

    安槐也没再说什么，低头吃面。

    但他的脑子没闲着。

    周小鱼是苏念念身边最亲近的朋友，林落雪选择从周小鱼切入，送笔记拉近关系，这步棋走得不急不躁。

    不直接接近苏念念，先渗透她的社交圈。

    这招在上辈子的职场里太常见了，专业名称叫“迂回社交渗透”。

    【巧合计数更新，林落雪选了跟苏念念同一天的灵气感知课是第一次，在南街“偶遇”是第二次，现在主动接近周小鱼是第三次。三次，宿主，按你自己的标准，已经超出巧合范畴了。】

    “我知道。”

    【那你打算怎么办？直接拆穿？】

    “拆穿什么？人家送笔记帮同学是好事，我说一句'她别有用心'，周小鱼信谁的？”

    【那就看着？】

    “看着，但不是干等着。”

    安槐喝了口汤，脑子里已经开始排列方案。

    他不需要阻止林落雪和周小鱼交朋友，那样做既没理由也没用，他只需要确保苏念念不会因为周小鱼的桥梁作用，被拉进林落雪的社交陷阱里。

    方法很简单，让苏念念保持自己的节奏就行。

    苏念念这个人有一个最大的优点，她只对真正合拍的人交心，不合拍的她自己会过滤。

    他要做的只是在关键时刻稍微提醒一下，别让她的大大咧咧变成被利用的突破口。
content_en:
Tuesday noon, cafeteria.

As soon as Su Niannian and An Huai sat down, Zhou Xiaoyu squeezed in from behind, the smile on his face several times brighter than usual.

"Nian Nian! Guess who sent me the notes?"

Su Niannian asked vaguely while chewing the braised pork."Who?"

"Lin Luoxue! She compiled a copy of the notes from the aura perception class and gave it to me, and even drew diagrams, which are very clear!"

Zhou Xiaoyu handed over a few pages of paper, and An Huai glanced at them. The handwriting was clear and neat, the key points were marked with colored pens, and the illustrations were drawn meticulously.

Really attentive.

Too attentive.

"How did she know you needed notes?" An Huai asked casually.

"I sent a message to the class group last time, saying that the content of the Aura Sensing class was a bit difficult to digest, so she sent me a private message and said that she could share her notes with me." Zhou Xiaoyu was so moved that his eyes lit up, "You are such a nice person."

Su Niannian looked at the note, hummed, didn't comment, and continued eating.

An Huai said nothing more and lowered his head to eat noodles.

But his mind was not idle.

Zhou Xiaoyu was Su Niannian's closest friend. Lin Luoxue chose to start with Zhou Xiaoyu and send notes to close the relationship. This move was done in a leisurely manner.

Don't approach Su Niannian directly, first penetrate her social circle.

This trick was so common in the workplace in my previous life, and its professional name is "circumferential social penetration."

[Update on the coincidence count. It was the first time that Lin Luoxue chose the spiritual energy perception class on the same day as Su Niannian. It was the second time that she "encountered" her by chance on South Street. Now it is the third time that she took the initiative to approach Zhou Xiaoyu.Three times, the host, according to your own standards, is beyond the scope of coincidence.】

"I know."

[Then what are you going to do?Dismantle it directly?】

"What are you exposing? It's a good thing for people to give notes to help classmates. If I say 'she has ulterior motives', who does Zhou Xiaoyu believe?"

[Then just watch?】

"Watch, but don't just wait."

An Huai took a sip of soup and started arranging plans in his mind.

He didn't need to prevent Lin Luoxue from making friends with Zhou Xiaoyu. There was no reason or use to do so. He just needed to ensure that Su Niannian would not be pulled into Lin Luoxue's social trap because of Zhou Xiaoyu's role as a bridge.

The method is very simple, just let Su Niannian maintain her own rhythm.

Su Niannian's biggest advantage is that she only communicates with people who are truly compatible with her, and she will filter out those who are not compatible with her.

All he had to do was give her a little reminder at the critical moment, so as not to let her carelessness become an opportunity for her to be exploited.
